correctness.rationale: Every uncolored vertex in the cubic prism has three positively colored neighbors, so its uncolored set is independent and has at most one vertex per rung. With at most two fully colored rungs all supports are enumerated by alternating runs. The internal color-sequence count is exactly R_l=2I if l=2 mod 3 and J-I otherwise, proved separately for lengths 1,2 and periodically for l>=3. The zero-, one-, and two-hole cases are exhaustive; odd/even endpoint-identification and unordered pair multiplicities yield all stated coefficients. Independent exact direct-label checks for n=3..5, support-based checks for n=3..24, and kernel checks through length 8 corroborate but do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The number of optimal singleton-three facility assignments is a natural missing extremal statistic following the published determination of their minimum weight. The classification distinguishes constant/linear/quadratic numbers of minimizers across all cycle-prism circumferences and determines two additional near-minimum weight coefficients. It is neither a trivial restatement of the minimum-weight formula nor an arbitrary finite graph census; the proof supplies a reusable exact two-terminal color kernel.
